Riley T: Heads-up: AP-589 actions still open. Owners in tracker: @Sophie M (post-deploy verification), @Harold K (runbook updates). Can you confirm status?
Sophie M: Blocking: need prod-like dataset slice for verification. Filed DATA-82 this morning.
Harold K: Runbook draft is 80% done, need someone to proof the rollback steps. Ivy, can you review?
Ivy N: I can review later today. Quick Q: what timeout values should we use in step 3?
Harold K: Using current default of 30s; may increase to 45s based on test results. I'll note that in the PR.
remind-bot: Reminder: AP-589 overdue actions. Escalation scheduled in 48h.
Riley T: We need hard ETAs by EOD or I'll reassign to on-call. This is the second postmortem this month delayed by data access. Suggest adding "confirm data access" to the action checklist.
Sophie M: Agree. Adding a new checklist item in the postmortem and linking DATA-82. ETA for verification: 2026-08-12 15:00 PT, pending dataset snapshot.
Ivy N: Reviewed runbook, left minor comments on PR: https://git.redwood.ai/org/repo/pull/623
Harold K: Addressed comments and updated step 3 timeout to 45s. Marking PR ready for merge.
remind-bot: Closure verification scheduled for 2026-08-13 17:00 PT.
Riley T: If DATA-82 isn't resolved by tomorrow noon I'll reassign Sophie to the on-call owner. Please update the tracker when snapshot is available.
Sophie M: Data snapshot approved and uploaded to staging. Running verification now, will post results to tracker in 30m.
Harold K: Runbook merged.
Ivy N: LGTM on runbook after edits.
Sophie M: Verification passed against snapshot. Updated tracker and marked the action as complete.
Riley T: Thanks all 97 marking AP-589 as verified. Creating a retro card for the recurring data-access blocker and assigning to Platform for process follow-up.
Service Reliability: Noted the pattern; will add "confirm data & env access" to the standard postmortem template and track enforcement.
